subject: Installation of rhdfs fails with Java runtime environment 6 not found on OS X Yosemite

messages.author: 1b0e7c294fe4fe36
messages.subject: Installation of rhdfs fails with Java runtime environment 6 not found on OS X Yosemite
parts:
Hello all,

I am trying to install rhdfs on OS X yosemite, and it fails with Java runtime environment 6 not found error. Though I have jdk1.8 installed on my box. I am also setting following environment from RStudio.
Sys.setenv("HADOOP_PREFIX"="/Users/analytics/Documents/hadoop-1.2.1")
Sys.setenv("HADOOP_CMD"="/Users/analytics/Documents/hadoop-1.2.1/bin/hadoop")
Sys.setenv("HADOOP_STREAMING"="/Users/analytics/Documents/hadoop-1.2.1/contrib/streaming/hadoop-streaming-1.2.1.jar")
Sys.setenv("JAVA_HOME"="/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/jdk1.8.0_05.jdk/Contents/Home")

Then I am executing

install.packages("/Users/analytics/Documents/RHadoop/rhdfs_1.0.8.tar.gz",repos=NULL,type="source")
after this it gives a box saying that "it cannot find Java runtime environment 6".

I am following step by step guide to install RHadoop at http://www.rdatamining.com/big-data/r-hadoop-setup-guide

Any help is appreciated.

Thanking you,
Sunil/

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: Installation of rhdfs fails with Java runtime environment 6 not found on OS X Yosemite
parts: Try R CMD javareconf to be sure that R is configured to use java. I don't think setting JAVA_HOME is enough
